annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2024 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: The EU Cyber Resilience Act sets horizontal, mandatory cybersecurity requirements for hardware and software products with digital elements placed on the EU market. It covers the product lifecycle, vulnerability handling, support periods, CE marking, risk-tiered conformity assessment and incident reporting. It interacts with the AI Act and Machinery Regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Essential cybersecurity requirements for design, development and vulnerability handling of all products with digital elements
Support period of at least five years with security updates; coordinated vulnerability disclosure and SBOMs
Tiered conformity assessment for important (class I/II) and critical products, with CE marking
Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents to CSIRTs and ENISA via a single reporting platform
High-risk AI systems meeting CRA requirements are deemed to comply with AI Act Article 15 cybersecurity requirements; Machinery Regulation synergies
